notes: Clean TRAIN30 main configuration: configs/serl_agentclinic_qwen4b_max7.json on the environment v13 (TRAIN 30 / DEV 31 / TEST 60, corrected diagnosis judge with the majority-v1 decision policy). Protocol, reward, GRPO settings, rubric method, causal validation and iterations are those of the pilot (configs/serl_agentclinic_qwen4b_max7_train30.json); the rubric budget is at most 8 per iteration. Runs, caches and tables are under outputs/serl_clean and outputs/main_experiments_train30_4b_clean; no artifact of the pilot is read. Effectiveness predictor connected after gRPC parity (outputs/effectiveness/v13_qwen4b_gemma12b_max7_train30_clean_majority/effectiveness_oof_v1).

effectiveness.notes: Frozen max7 joint predictor; TRAIN-only selection/calibration; DEV evaluated once; actual gRPC parity passed.

selection.max_rubrics_notes: At most 8 rubrics per iteration: the largest effectiveness gaps among those that pass validation, consolidation and the gap filter; fewer pass -> all of them (frozen 2026-10-02 before any rubric of the pilot or of this run was generated).

physical_gpus.policy: one GPU per run, set by CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES of the launch script
physical_gpus.effectiveness_service: one shared service process on its own GPU (EFFECTIVENESS_GPU of the launch scripts)

intervention.notes: FINAL MAIN (frozen 2026-10-03): Rubric Validation with the frozen score-2 intervention. The failed turn's response is written by the iteration's Agent under the candidate's ideal behavior; the first of at most 3 attempts that the run's rubric scorer (Jev) puts at score 2 of the candidate is frozen and inserted as it is in the 3 reruns from the same prefix; pass at >= 2 of 3 correct final diagnoses. No private re-assessment (diagnostic only, outputs/serl_clean/clean30_4b_ours_reassess_20261003-084101_b45e62fa), no behavioral criterion.
